title: Mastoid
summary: MAS'TOID, adjective [Gr. the nipple or breast, and form.] Resembling the nipple or breast; as the mastoid muscle; the mastoid process.

inlines.v: MAS'TOID, adjective [Gr. the nipple or breast, and form.] Resembling the nipple or breast; as the mastoid muscle; the mastoid process.
